NOW, THEREFORE, I, GLORIA MACAPAGAL-ARROYO, President of
the Republic of the Philippines, by virtue of the powers vested in me by law, do
hereby authorize the Development Bank of the Philippines (DBP) to acquire for
and on behalf of the Department of Foreign Affairs (DA) the properties in the
following locations that are available for acquisition, namely: (1) Seoul, South
Korea; (2) Amman, Jordan; (3) Pretoria, South Africa; (4) Los Angeles,
California, U.S.A.; (5) Dubai, U.A.E.; (6) Berlin, Germany; (7) Chicago, Illinois,
U.S.A.; (8) Rome, Italy; (9) Milan, Italy; (10) Vatican City; (11) Mexico City,
Mexico; (12) London, U.K.; (13) Brunei Darussalam; (14) Geneva, Switzerland;
(15) Hanoi, Vietnam; (16) Athens, Greece; (17) Manama, Bahrain; and (18)
Brussels, Belgium, to be used as chanceries, consulates and official residences of
the heads of Foreign Service Posts overseas; (19) La Union, Philippines; (20)
Davao, Philippines; (21) Zamboanga, Philippines; (22) Cebu, Philippines; and
(23) Iloilo, Philippines, to be used as Regional Consular Offices in the Philippines;
and such other properties for acquisition as may be identified by the DA for said
purposes. The DA is also authorized to utilize the Building Fund and the annual
rental appropriation for the said properties covered by a Multi-Year Obligational
Authority (MYOA) to be issued by the Department of Budget and Management
(DBM) to cover any advances, attendant costs and expenses of the DBP.
Furthermore, the DBP and DA are hereby directed to formulate the
necessary procedures to implement the foregoing.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 28 thday of May
Lord, Two Thousand Ten.
